assets.description: Figure 2.2: A three-layer protocol. assets.description: Figure 2.7: Identical objects in the TCP/IP protocol suite. Source host, router, and destination host are aligned by layers. assets.description: Figure 2.8: Encapsulation/Decapsulation. Source host, router, and destination host show encapsulation and decapsulation. At the source, transport header 4, network header 3, and data-link header 2 are added around the message. The router removes and replaces link-layer framing while forwarding the network packet. The destination removes headers 2, 3, and 4 to recover the message.
